title: EM1 e Electric (Adventure Spec)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Honda EM1 e Electric (Adventure Spec) is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
